composition: User-selected daytime panorama with the Hollywood sign and a small USC campus in a flat urban neighborhood. Lighting variants use that composition as image 1 and their October 21 counterparts as palette-only references.

prompts.day:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Los Angeles skyline desktop background, one landscape 3:2 illustration, 1536x1024.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Revise ONLY the lower foreground area containing USC and its surrounding neighborhood. The current image makes USC too large and places it in an incorrect lush leafy hillside setting.
USC must become a SMALL supporting urban detail: reduce the campus group by another roughly 35 percent from its current scale. Place its compact red-brown brick academic buildings around x=25–43% and y=73–84% of the image. The clock tower should now be only about 7–8 percent of total image height, a modest square tower among city blocks, not a grand foreground monument. Keep a small but readable cardinal-red campus banner reading exactly "USC" once on one horizontal line in gold. Do not create a grand lawn, estate entrance or a sprawling palace.
CRITICAL TERRAIN AND NEIGHBORHOOD CORRECTION: USC is in the flat, dense urban fabric south of downtown Los Angeles. Replace the surrounding lush sloped woodland and villas with a FLAT compact urban street grid: tightly spaced low-rise brick and stucco buildings, beige and gray flat roofs, visible asphalt cross streets, sidewalks, a few parking lots, mixed modest commercial and residential blocks, utility details and sparse street trees. The campus can have a small courtyard and a handful of palms, but it must sit inside a continuous city block, without a forest, green hillside, expansive lawn or garden estate around it. Restore a few ordinary buildings in front of and beside the campus so it blends naturally into the neighborhood. Keep the foreground subdued; no city model, dollhouse or aerial map look.
Preserve EXACTLY the existing HOLLYWOOD sign and hillside in the upper-left background, including spelling and size. Preserve downtown skyscrapers, US Bank Tower, Wilshire Grand, skyline scale and placement, distant mountains, sky and cloud pattern, late-morning daylight, restrained color palette, fine dithered editorial pixel-painting style and 3:2 composition. Keep the tall palms at the outer edges as framing, but remove the excessive canopy around USC.
Downtown and Hollywood should be the first things the eye sees; USC is a smaller discoverable landmark. Text only "HOLLYWOOD" on the distant hillside and small "USC" on the campus banner. Return one finished full-bleed image.

Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: Los Angeles desktop-app background, one full-bleed 1536x1024 landscape 3:2 illustration.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the user's SELECTED EXACT COMPOSITION MASTER. It shows a small USC campus within a flat urban neighborhood, palms and mixed street trees, the Hollywood sign on the left hillside, and downtown LA dominating the middle distance. Image 2 is the OLD DAWN artwork, provided ONLY as a lighting and color palette reference. Use image 1 for ALL geometry and layout; do not restore image 2's old foreground.
Create the matching DAWN edition of IMAGE 1. Change ONLY the time-of-day lighting and atmospheric colors.
Preserve EXACTLY the viewpoint, skyline, every tower shape and position, street grid, low-rise buildings, rooftop details, flat foreground terrain, palms, tree positions and density, hill shapes, sky and cloud layout, and fine dithered editorial pixel-painting texture. Do not change the balance of greenery versus urban buildings. The USC campus and its clock tower must remain the exact same SMALL size and placement as image 1, integrated with the flat urban blocks; no enlargement, added gardens or extra campus buildings.
Preserve the Hollywood sign's size and location and exact nine-letter spelling "HOLLYWOOD". Preserve the small cardinal-red campus banner with exactly "USC" written once in gold on one horizontal line. It must remain three letters U S C; never wrap, repeat or replace letters.
Lighting: The first quiet daylight around 6 am: a pale dusty rose and apricot horizon fading into cool pearl-blue sky, delicate warm peach highlights on east-facing upper facades, cool blue-gray foreground shadows, a few lingering warm window lights, subtle marine haze. Hollywood's white letters remain clearly readable and USC's little red-and-gold banner remains legible.
No new landmarks, streets, trees, people, water, extra lettering, captions, UI, border, watermark, giant sun or moon, neon, fireworks or purple fantasy. Return one finished DAWN image, not a grid.
